children: Markets held on to moderate gains at noon on Monday, November 16, 2026, with both benchmark indices trading higher despite profit-booking near the week’s previous highs. The Nifty 50 was at 25,256.65, up 112.35 points or 0.45 per cent, as of 1 PM, while the BSE Sensex traded at 82,038.95, up 446.50 points or 0.55 per cent. The Nifty had opened at 25,206.15 against its previous close of 25,144.30, while the Sensex opened at 81,810.98 against its prior close of 81,592.45.

Bank Nifty was the standout performer during the session, scaling a fresh all-time high in intraday trade. PSU bank stocks led sectoral gains, rising more than 1 per cent. The top three positive contributors to the Nifty were Bharti Airtel, HDFC Bank and ITC. Among sectoral indices, Nifty FMCG was the best performer while Nifty Realty was the worst performing sector. Metal shares also came under mild pressure. “Meaningful call writing was witnessed across 25,300 and 25,400 strikes. On the put side, 25,200 has a substantial open interest, followed by 25,100,” said SBI Securities in its mid-market note.

title: Nifty holds 0.45% gains at noon; Bank Nifty hits all-time high, TMPV slumps 8%
